milestones.label: Applications open for 2027 entry (both rounds)
milestones.source_text: Gates Cambridge's timeline page (official) says applications open on 11 September 2026.

milestones.label: Application deadline (US citizens resident in the USA)
milestones.source_text: Gates Cambridge (official) gives 14 October 2026 for the earlier round, covering US citizens living in the US; all documents including references are due.

milestones.label: Application deadline (all other applicants; set by the course funding deadline)
milestones.source_text: Gates Cambridge (official) says the later round closes on 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027, whichever the Cambridge Course Directory lists as the course's funding deadline.

milestones.label: Scholarship offers, US citizens round
milestones.source_text: Gates Cambridge (official) says offers in the earlier round go out by early February 2027, after applicants are notified of shortlisting by 14 December 2026.

milestones.label: Scholarship offers, later round
milestones.source_text: Gates Cambridge (official) says offers in the later round go out by early April 2027, after applicants are notified by 8 March 2027.
